hosted_read_only_build_verification.behavior: Production build bundles read-only profile where realWritesEnabled() evaluates to false, rendering runtime action triggers and menu items disabled with NON_PRODUCTION_COMMAND_REASON title and preventing any runActionSafe or HighRiskConfirm invocation.

readOnlyProfile.behavior: When VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES is false, runtime action controls are disabled across the UI.
uiGuards: Dropdown trigger button is disabled with aria-disabled='true' and title set to NON_PRODUCTION_COMMAND_REASON
All DropdownMenuItems (restart, drain, move, scale, disable_new, quarantine, inspect_logs, emergency_kill) are disabled when canAct is false
run() mutation handler validates realWritesEnabled() and returns early if writes are disabled
HighRiskConfirm modal open prop is conditioned on realWritesEnabled() and onConfirm validates realWritesEnabled() before dispatching

realWriteProfile.behavior: When VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES is true, governed runtime mutations are enabled for non-fleetDerived rows.
supportedActions: restart: dispatches restart mutation to runActionSafe with success toast
disable_new: maps to quarantine action with memo 'disable_new_deployments'
emergency_kill: opens HighRiskConfirm dialog enforcing minimum 80-character audit memo and confirmation token before dispatching
fleetDerived: remains disabled even in real-write mode to prevent invalid mutations on derived fleet aggregates

read_only_build.command: npm run build (with strict-live read-only environment variables)
